accepted_static_checks: Projection hooks installed outside infer_batch, therefore remain active through all generation forwards
Each decoder input, attention output and MLP output is projected; tuple output structure preserved
Captures are restricted to the initial forward via batch_hook; generation does not overwrite candidate captures
zero_sham returns the exact input tensor and retains the same hook locations
Projection and capture handles removed in finally; postcall inventory and active-hooks guard
Two executor threads, Modal max_containers2, no retries, hard deadline guard and conservative app-wall reservation
Same request ordering is supported; actual crossarm cohort equality must be audited by workflow/engineering smoke
required_fixes: Bind both refusal and random intervention specs to immutable expected SHA256 values in intervention-lock.json and reject a changed registry spec
Require a passed intervention-qualified receipt that is bound to the same lock; mere existence is insufficient
Reject nonlocked direction_key for a/b/c science requests; candidate selection keys are shared-only
numerical_requirements: BF16 recasting can leave a small nonzero directional residual; smoke must use an explicit reasonable tolerance and record before/after numerical residuals
Exact baseline/zero-sham output-token and first-probability identity on identical cohorts
Verify each site is reached on prompt and generation forwards and no hook leaks after an exception
Verify direction hash from payload in the worker as well as broker
scope: Static independent source review only. No cloud launch, local model loading or numerical smoke was performed by this reviewer.
